description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Divine Light Aegis
sections.description_summary: selects a tile and grants allies on it and adjacent tiles a shield absorbing 470% ATK damage for 10 s; shield scales to 520% ATK.

sections.name: Divine Bash
sections.description_summary: shield bash deals 70% ATK damage to an enemy and knocks them back; Lucius also gains a shield absorbing 300% ATK for 8 s. Higher level adds a 1 s stun.

sections.name: Divine Light Blessing
sections.description_summary: whenever Lucius gains a shield, he heals the weakest ally for 80% ATK + 20% of shield value. Higher levels improve the shield effect.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases Healing by 11/15/19.

sections.name: Sacred Beam
sections.description_summary: fires a frontal 3-tile-wide, 4-tile-long beam, damaging enemies and reducing their ATK. Higher levels add a shield per enemy hit and increase the ATK reduction.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Lucius heals one additional ally with Divine Light Blessing.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: increases shield value provided by Lucius. When granting an ally a shield, increases their Phys & Magic DEF for 8 s; higher ranks also heal for a percentage of the shield value.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: below 60% HP, reduces damage taken and restores lost HP over 8 s, up to once every 20 s; refine adds Vitality and Healing.

sections.name: Quake Slam
sections.description_summary: against an adjacent enemy, knocks them airborne and slams them in place; against an enemy closer to Lucca's allied backline, charges and slams them back to his original tile. The slam deals 200% ATK to the target and adjacent enemies and stuns them for 2 s. Lucca is immune to control while casting; auto-cast prioritizes targets nearer his allied backline.

sections.name: Ruthless Ram
sections.description_summary: Lucca gains a shield based on both Phys DEF and Magic DEF, then charges an enemy, dealing damage, interrupting and disarming them for 4 s.

sections.name: Courageous Call
sections.description_summary: removes dispellable debuffs from Lucca and reduces his damage taken for 5 s; can be cast while under dispellable control.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases max HP by 17/23/29%.

sections.name: Unshakeable Ties
sections.description_summary: gains a shield for each ally placed in an adjacent tile behind him at battle start; those supporting allies also gain ATK. Higher level expands Ruthless Ram's area when at least two allies support him.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: casting Courageous Call restores 15% HP. LV 2 increases Phys & Magic DEF of adjacent allies behind Lucca during preparation; when one takes damage, Lucca automatically casts his Ultimate on a valid attacker once per battle without consuming Energy.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: reduces damage taken for each enemy within 1 tile, up to a cap. Higher ranks periodically damage nearby enemies and reduce their ATK.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: below 60% HP, reduces damage taken and restores lost HP over 8 s, up to once every 20 s; refine adds Vitality and Crit DMG DEF.

sections.name: Annihilation Directive
sections.description_summary: at battle start, if an ally is one tile behind Gunnar, he creates a Doomfield at that ally's location, increasing their normal attack range and ATK based on Gunnar's initial ATK. Gunnar and the ally remain steadfast while the field condition holds. Active cast bombards the target area, then creates fire for 15 s; enemies in fire take periodic damage and lose Vitality.

sections.name: Bombing Engine
sections.description_summary: fires six cannon strikes around Gunnar's locked-on target. If a Doomfield is active, the ally in it performs six coordinated attacks that damage and stun the locked-on target.

sections.name: Absolute Defense
sections.description_summary: grants Gunnar a shield and shields every ally behind him. If Doomfield is active, increases the attack speed of the ally inside it.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases Ranged DEF and Vitality, with additional amounts for each allied hero behind Gunnar.

sections.name: Fire Suppression
sections.description_summary: when the Doomfield ally deals enough cumulative damage, Gunnar launches a missile at his locked target and heals based on damage dealt. LV 4 makes the Doomfield ally invincible and grants ATK while Gunnar remains above the stated HP threshold.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: if Doomsday Meteor hits an area already set on fire, it becomes permanently scorched. Enemies in the scorched area cannot heal or gain shields.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: opening ranged-damage bonus for the ally one tile behind Gunnar; higher ranks grant that ally a shield the first time their HP falls below 50%.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: below 60% HP, reduces damage taken and restores lost HP over 8 s, up to once every 20 s; refine adds Crit Resist and Crit DMG DEF.

sections.name: Detention Pass
sections.description_summary: opening concealment makes Contess untargetable and inactive while recovering Energy. When she enters, the active effect heals an ally and grants Exemption; Exemption converts part of ongoing HP loss into a shield and increases ATK while the shield holds. Another active effect heals the two weakest allies and reduces ATK of the two highest-damage enemies.

sections.name: Quiet Period
sections.description_summary: Code of Conduct — Be Quiet is violated whenever a unit casts an Ultimate, with a per-unit violation cooldown.

sections.name: Expulsion Notice
sections.description_summary: repeatedly punished units can be permanently expelled, silenced and suffer additional HP loss.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: regular battles apply stun or silence for specific rule violations; Boss battles add an extra punishment.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: healing an ally increases their ATK temporarily; higher ranks increase Contess's Healing after a total-healing threshold.

sections.name: Hailing Arrows
sections.description_summary: passive charged normal attack deals 360% ATK; active cast rains arrows over a selected tile and surrounding area, damaging and immobilizing enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target in one wave deal reduced damage.

sections.name: Fulgur Arrow
sections.description_summary: the page confirms this tag and a three-attack normal-attack cycle.

sections.name: Seed Siphon
sections.description_summary: teleports to an enemy, prevents them from moving or acting, deals damage and drains 220 Energy, then plants a Drain Seed. The seed periodically damages its host and drains Energy. Up to eight seeds may exist at once.

capture_status_notes: returned excerpt only contains the Ultimate and its scaling; all other skills and progression sections still require recapture.

sections.name: Living Armor - Kensuke
sections.description_summary: summons Living Armor with infinite HP and its own Energy pool. It loses Energy over time and from damage, then recharges and returns to combat. Recasting restores its Energy, grants control immunity and increases its ATK SPD.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases Laios's ATK.

sections.name: Ingredient Analysis
sections.description_summary: against monsters (not heroes or their summons), causes extra ingredient drops at HP-loss thresholds and increases damage to monsters.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: each different ingredient collected using Dungeon Gourmet permanently increases Laios's max HP, up to three times.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: increases ATK and Phys & Magic DEF for the caster and units they create; higher ranks add Haste after 5 s.

sections.name: Wild Shift
sections.description_summary: immobilizes two rearmost enemies, teleports them to a target tile and drops them, damaging and knocking down enemies there. Pippa has a chance for skills to go out of control, teleporting their target to a random enemy-side location.

sections.name: Mad Missiles
sections.description_summary: fires nine magic missiles at enemies in quick succession.

sections.name: Mage's Bloom
sections.description_summary: prevents the first cast from going out of control and gives each cast a chance to mutate; mutation adds area true damage and immobilization around the target.

sections.name: Heroic Slash
sections.description_summary: performs nine slashes in a frontal area, followed by a sweep that deals damage plus true damage based on target max HP.

sections.name: Heroic Dash
sections.description_summary: dashes to the two enemies with the highest cumulative damage, damages and knocks them down, then returns.

sections.name: Hero Party
sections.description_summary: if at least one Mage, Tank and Support are adjacent, forms a party with one ally of each class, increasing basic stats and granting a shared permanent shield. Active cast damages a target and converts part of damage into healing for party members.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: in Boss fights, Himmel and party members cause increased HP loss to Boss targets.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: increases ATK when the caster is displaced by their own skills; higher ranks add a shield.

sections.name: Smashing Assault
sections.description_summary: deals damage and applies one stack of Shatter Armor.

sections.name: Vital Strike
sections.description_summary: attacks adjacent enemies with at least four Shatter Armor stacks and not affected by Vulnerable, dealing damage and inflicting Vulnerable.
